title: Capitolo 0 — Origine (2016–2018: Il Patto con Sleep, i Ruoli Rituali, One, Two e i Singoli)

the_pact_with_sleep.summary: Nel settembre 2016 il progetto si presenta con il comunicato Basick Records: Sleep è una divinità antica che ha governato le civiltà primordiali attraverso il dono del sogno. È apparsa in sogno a Vessel promettendogli 'gloria e magnificenza' in cambio di servitù e adorazione ('Worship'). Ogni brano registrato è un 'Token' (offerta votiva) e ogni concerto è un 'Ritual'.

canon_quotes.quote: How we got here is as irrelevant as who we are – what matters is the music and the message. We are here to serve Sleep and project His message.
canon_quotes.source_title: Metal Hammer / Louder - Who and what the hell are Sleep Token? (2017)

canon_quotes.quote: He is everywhere, at all times. Vessel encountered Sleep in a dream, with promise of glory and magnificence if Vessel followed Him.
canon_quotes.source_title: Metal Hammer / Louder - Who and what the hell are Sleep Token? (2017)

kerrang_wayback_recovered.excerpt: With the hidden identities behind bands like Poland’s Slavonic-speaking black metallers Batushka and Sweden’s Ghost being unveiled to a curious public in recent times, it means that the similarly secretive Sleep Token might just be the most compelling group with their masks still in place. And, as they’ve already proven, the band are more than capable of playing up to this role of intrigue. When the anonymous collective emerged just over two years ago, dressed in Death Eater-style robes and looking ready to sacrifice your pet goat, their leader, known only as Vessel, told of an age-old deity called ‘Sleep’ – a name chosen as no proper translation exists in any modern tongue. They also came bearing allusions to ancient civilisations, with early songs named Calcutta, Nazareth and Jericho.

And yet for all this dark mystery and carefully constructed enigma, perhaps what surprises most about Sleep Token is the way they sound. Despite a supremely witchy aesthetic that hints at the gloomiest doom unearthed from some rotting catacomb, the main fabric of their debut is a mix of chilling electronics and otherworldly pop, with a sinister heaviness only intruding on the fringes. These are songs that share less with the metal of the similarly-robed Sunn O))), and more with, say, Deaf Havana’s slower, more pensive and thoughtful moments.

Admittedly, save for Gods – the record’s only true out-and-out metalcore song – the continuous nature of this dark mood entwined with the group’s slow-burning, listless pace does begin to drag across Sundowner’s 50-minute runtime. But there are moments here to truly savour, and ideas and experiences that feel unique. The band have shown they can create vast episodes that exist primarily within their ancient universe, while also feeling very vulnerable and human at their core. That alone should be reason enough to hope that Sleep Token’s secretive allure stays intact for a long time to come.

origin_narrative.worship_vs_toxic_relationship: Fin da 'Thread the Needle' e 'When the Bough Breaks', la scrittura di Vessel usa un doppio registro inseparabile: sul piano del mito è una liturgia di sottomissione a un dio antico; sul piano emotivo è la cronaca di una relazione tossica, codipendente e non ricambiata, in cui il narratore oscilla tra supplica ('Fields of Elation', 'Jericho') e rabbia predatoria ('Nazareth', 'Jaws').

ritual_roles.Vessel: Unico frontman, autore dei testi e canalizzatore vocale/pianistico del messaggio di Sleep. Nella fase 2016-2018 indossa una maschera di tessuto/cappuccio con il primo emblema dipinto o inciso sul volto e pittura corporale nera su collo, braccia e torso per cancellare i tratti umani.
ritual_roles.II: Batterista e secondo pilastro compositivo/ritmico del collettivo. Indossa maschera e cappuccio con il simbolo della band; guida la transizione stilistica tra gospel, R&B, blast beat e djent.
ritual_roles.III: Bassista nei Rituals dal vivo. Figura scenica mobile che interagisce con la congregazione (il pubblico) mantenendo il voto del silenzio verbale e il volto coperto.
ritual_roles.IV: Chitarrista nei Rituals dal vivo (chitarre baritone / 8 corde e cori screamed dal vivo). Completa il quartetto strumentale numerato in cifre romane per negare l'ego individuale.
ritual_roles.Espera: Trio vocale femminile che accompagna i Rituals come coro liturgico vivente. Il nome richiama i Vespri (preghiere della sera/tramonto) e l'attesa ('espera'), vestite e mascherate in coordinate rituali con Vessel.

Vessel.excerpt: Vessel's appearance has notably changed for each major "era" that corresponds to their musical releases.

Most recently, in early 2025, Vessel's new look was unveiled with the release of "Emergence" from Even In Arcadia. This appearance retained most of the previous one's design elements, such as the pauldron and six-eyed mask. Notably, Vessel's cloak is now dark green with gold trim, rather than black as in his previous appearances. His mask has gold accents with the logo in dark green as well. The silky white leg wraps from the previous era are replaced by green-and-gold knight greaves. His pauldron is now more adorned with pink gems and gold accents, and the fur has been replaced with black feathers. He also wears many gold necklaces and rings.

Vessel's mask has an opening for his mouth; the red logo stays, with some red around the opening area. He wears a long black cloak with gray fur on the back and a pauldron on his left shoulder, its strap visible across his chest. This pauldron has a variant with gold coral and another with gray fur. He also wears many silver necklaces and rings that change in different tours. He also wears silky black pants with white leg wraps and black tabi shoes.

This era marked the debut of six eye holes rather than two, as well as the revised logo. As with the Early EPs, there are two variants of the mask, the full mask used for the videos of "The Love You Want", "Alkaline" and in photoshoots, and the other with a cutout for his mouth for live performances. The cutout variant of this mask was also seen in the Blood Sport (from the room below) music video. He retains the same black cloak.

II.excerpt: II, also known as Vessel2, is the drummer for the English band Sleep Token. For studio recordings, he is credited for the drums and percussion.[1]

III.excerpt: III is a touring member of the band Sleep Token, playing the bass guitar during performances.

IV.excerpt: IV is a touring member of the band, Sleep Token, playing the guitar during performances, as well as handling backing vocals, mainly for screaming vocals.
